description.p: The installer used by ShaniOS live images. It is a fork of GNOME's os-installer and provides the Adwaita interface ShaniOS ships: language, keyboard, disk and encryption selection, user setup, then the distro's own prepare/install/configure scripts.
ShaniOS specific behaviour comes from /etc/os-installer and its config.yaml, not from this package.
First release of the ShaniOS fork:

ul.li: Runs install scripts through bash instead of exec'ing them directly
Optional root password, with its state shown on the summary page
Encryption and root-password rows on the summary page
Fix generated usernames never being used
Fix a race when reading the fixed language from the config
Fix the keyboard language fallback tuple
Use the EFI partition device path rather than its name

description.p: Last release inherited from upstream os-installer.
